## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the GitHub issue and any
related API MR; cross-repository API work remains in its owning tracker.

## Validation

Record Ruff, mypy, package verification and relevant contract/example tests.
Document compatibility, credential handling or charge/retry implications.

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit title; focused feature branch.
- [ ] Checks pass and runnable documentation matches behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, build outputs or engine source.
- [ ] Contract/provenance and release/deployment boundaries are preserved.
